document:0:126:0.text:
Mix the <style="highlight">Ryeham flour</style> with eggs for the batter.
Cut the <style="highlight">large apples</style> into cubes and cook them with sugar, butter, and cinnamon.
Heat the mixture of fresh cream and <style="highlight">premium honey</style>, then stir it well.
Spread the apple jam between the two cake layers, drizzle the honey sauce over the cake, and decorate before serving.
document:0:126:0.source_cn:
将<style="highlight">金穗村精制面粉</style>混合鸡蛋制成蛋糕胚
<style="highlight">又大又甜的苹果</style>切块，以砂糖、奶油、肉桂进行炒制
将鲜奶油混合<style="highlight">上等蜂蜜</style>加热搅拌均匀
将苹果酱涂抹在蛋糕胚中间，淋以蜂蜜奶油酱，装点后即可
